pages.text: I can shift a compatible undead creature into another related state.

$(bold)Mana:$() ½ bucket$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)Aim at a supported undead within twelve blocks. The spell follows its curated transformation cycle, replacing the entity while preserving position and selected common data. Unsupported undead cannot be targeted.
